text: The ignored-subscription discovery test disables usingSubscription, creates both subscribed and unsubscribed top-level and Inbox-child mailboxes, then checks that all named folders are discovered. It also waits1000ms before an Inbox update. The author reports that a shorter fake-server delay still loses the connection and does not establish the cause; the final source retains the delay and explanatory comment. This scoped historical test exception does not reverse the preference for event or state waits. The reviewer prefers should-form assertion messages, while the final messages still say discovered; that local outcome does not change deliberate user writing guidance. Bug comment24 is unavailable; zero full-audit credit and no test ran.
title: Distinguish IMAP discovery assertions from the retained fixture delay
